items.title: ❗️Swiss voters overwhelmingly — by more than 70% — rejected a far-right initiative that sought to enshrine a stricter interpretation of neutrality in the constitution. Had it passed, the country would have been unable to join sanctions against Russia for the invasion of Ukraine unless they were approved by the UN Security Council, where Moscow holds a veto. The result confirmed that Switzerland retains the ability to stand with the democratic world and continue a sanctions policy aligned with the EU.

items.title: ￼❗️President Zelenskyy, following a report from Commander-in-Chief Drapatyi, stated that over the past week the Armed Forces of Ukraine neutralized 10,660 Russian troops killed and wounded across all sectors of active fighting; according to him, every loss is accompanied by video confirmation. He noted important results on the Lyman direction as part of Operation Vivaldi and another active-defense operation involving the Air Assault Forces (without details), and separately praised the 3rd Army Corps and the 68th Separate Airmobile Brigade. The most intense fighting is currently ongoing on the Pokrovsk, Kostyantynivka, and Lyman directions; further active steps have been determined together with the Commander-in-Chief.

He noted important results on the Lyman direction as part of Operation Vivaldi and another active-defense operation involving the Air Assault Forces (without details), and separately praised the 3rd Army Corps and the 68th Separate Airmobile Brigade. The most intense fighting is currently ongoing on the Pokrovsk, Kostyantynivka, and Lyman directions; further active steps have been determined together with the Commander-in-Chief.

items.title: RT by @Maks_NAFO_FELLA: 🇰🇵❗️North Korea has launched mass production of kamikaze drones, — Budanov “North Korea is learning from our war and arming itself. The world should see this connection while there is time. It has long been known that, in addition to supplying weapons and materials to Russia, North Korea is sending its troops directly to fight against Ukraine. In parallel, North Korea itself is improving its weapons based on the experience of combat operations in Ukraine. It is also adopting new types of weapons, some of which are Russian-made. And this does not contribute to stability in the Korean region. And when you see how the North Korean regime is militarizing so rapidly, the question naturally arises: why? First of all, to be ready for active combat operations in its region. The situation is getting worse every day. And it is only a matter of time before a trigger event occurs that will lead to uncontrollable consequences.”
